data.disclaimer: Research and decision support only. Not investment advice.
data.plain_english: A Hong Kong technology index said it will add ten fast-growing companies and grow to 50 companies in December. The council thinks this could help Hong Kong tech shares, because funds that copy the index may need to buy them. But Hong Kong shares have been falling lately, so the help may come later rather than now. In the US, higher interest rates are making life harder for banks and property companies. The biggest disagreement is over Mainland China tech, which has dropped sharply: some think it is due for a bounce and others think the weakness will continue. This is research to help you think, not advice to buy or sell anything.

risk.method: council view 35% (negative views only), volatility 25% (8-25%), 1-month drawdown 20% (0 to -6%), disagreement 10%, unverified claims 10%; portfolio adds up to 10 points for market concentration
